name: Uniform collapse (spherical)
blurb: Gas (gamma = 5/3) falling inward at a speed proportional to radius, u = -r, so that all of it would reach the origin at t = 1 (ExactPack’s noh2). It stays uniform as it is squeezed along its adiabat, with no shock: at t = 0.5 the density is 8 times its start everywhere. The open outer face cannot push gas in as the exact solution would, and a rarefaction runs in from it at the sound speed: the box reaches out to r = 3 so that it stays outside r = 0.9 (0.26 in the planar box) by t = 0.5.
